** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Assert the serialized `token_id` values in the new candidate test.** The test checks only the Rust `token_id` fields returned by `convert_backend_top_logprobs`. It does not check how those values serialize. This change alters a client-visible response field, and the protocol checklist requires an end-to-end regression for such a change. Serialization changes in `TopLogprobs` would pass this test unchanged. Add a serialized-output assertion for the three IDs. This covers the wire representation of `Some` values.
Suggested test addition

```diff let ids: Vec<_> = out.iter().map(|e| e.token_id).collect(); assert_eq!(ids, vec![Some(2), Some(7), Some(1)]); + let json = serde_json::to_value(&out).unwrap(); + assert_eq!(json[0]["token_id"], 2); + assert_eq!(json[1]["token_id"], 7); + assert_eq!(json[2]["token_id"], 1); ```

The Python chat processors still discard the same available candidate IDs: `components/src/dynamo/frontend/vllm_processor.py:229-235` appends only `"token"`, `"logprob"`, and `"bytes"` despite computing `entry_token_id`, and `components/src/dynamo/frontend/sglang_prepost.py:1298-1304` does likewise despite reading `candidate.get("token_id")`. Consequently, `/v1/chat/completions` with `--dyn-chat-processor vllm` or `sglang` still loses IDs for equal-text alternatives. Preserve candidate `token_id` in both response builders to apply this fix across the supported chat processors.

Include each available backend candidate token_id in the top_logprobs dictionaries built by both Python chat processors.

</details>

**Explanation** The title "fix(llm): populate token_id on top_logprobs candidates" names the main change. The changeset sets token_id on top_logprobs candidates in convert_backend_top_logprobs (lib/llm/src/protocols/openai.rs) and adds a regression test. The title is concise, specific, and follows a conventional commit style. The vLLM generate clearing step is a secondary detail and does not need to appear in the title.

**Explanation** The description follows the repository template. It has an Overview, Key Changes, and Validation section. It links issue `#19075` with "Fixes `#19075`", which covers the Issues and Ongoing Work intent. The Overview explains the defect and its cause. Key Changes lists the modified file and the new test. Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All three changed areas connect to the linked issue. The convert_backend_top_logprobs change in lib/llm/src/protocols/openai.rs is the response-builder fix the issue requests. The new test in delta.rs verifies that fix. The clear of entry.token_id in lib/generate-formats/vllm/src/generate.rs keeps the vLLM generate wire shape unchanged. That helper is shared, so the clear is needed to prevent the fix from changing that output. No unrelated changes were found in the diff.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#19075` asks for three coding outcomes: (a) an owned TopLogprobs type with an optional u32 token_id that is omitted when absent, (b) native candidate IDs preserved in Dynamo's response builder, and (c) tests for equal-text candidates with distinct IDs and for OpenAI-shaped entries without IDs. Requirement (b) is met. In lib/llm/src/protocols/openai.rs, convert_backend_top_logprobs now sets token_id from top_lp.token_id and from selected_token_id. Requirement (a) is not shown by this PR. The code uses dynamo_protocols::types::TopLogprobs, which already has a token_id field at the reviewed head. Its source is not in this repository, so the omit-when-absent serde behavior and the deserialize/reserialize round trip from the issue reproduction cannot be checked here. Requirement (c) is only partly covered. test_chat_top_logprobs_candidates_carry_token_id uses candidates with different text ('hi', 'yo') and checks IDs [Some(2), Some(7), Some(1)]. It does not cover equal decoded text with distinct IDs, the no-ID OpenAI-shaped case, or the round-trip wire case. **Resolution** To decide this assessment, provide one of the following: (1) the source or serde test for dynamo_protocols::types::TopLogprobs showing that token_id is optional, omitted when None, and round-trips through ChatCompletionTokenLogprob; or (2) a test that deserializes the issue reproduction JSON, reserializes it, and checks both candidate token_id values. Also provide a test with two candidates that have equal text and distinct IDs, and a test for an OpenAI-shaped entry without token_id.
